subject: Renewal: Dedicated capacity increase for BrightCart — model upgrade & reranker
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana@brightcart.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation — Dedicated capacity + model upgrade

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the heads up about the upcoming renewal on May 15. Based on your note that BrightCart will evaluate a move to a larger 32k-context model and a reranker add-on for search relevance, I wanted to pre-surface an initial plan so we can avoid last-minute slippage.

Proposed at-a-glance:
- Term: 12 months (starts on renewal date)
- Reserved capacity: 8x A100 GPUs for generation (model-32k), 4x A10 for reranker pool
- Throughput guarantee: 450 concurrent prompt tokens/sec baseline, 900 token/sec burst
- Optional: 20% price uplift for expanded context; can rebalance across reserved pools

Attached: BrightCart_Renewal_Proposal_v1.pdf (high-level commercial and SOW stub). If this looks directionally correct I'll pull in Prio (SE) and legal to draft the binding SOW and updated SLA.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm expected peak QPS and average context length for the reranker? That will help us finalize sizing.
2) Loop in procurement contact so we can share commercial terms.

Appreciate it — happy to set a 30-min slot this week if useful.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
v: (415) 555-0187
From: Dana Li <dana@brightcart.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@brightcart.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:04:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — Dedicated capacity + model upgrade

Vanessa,

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns with what the product team expects. A few clarifying items before procurement will engage:
- Peak QPS for the user-facing generate path: ~120 req/s with average 6k tokens/context. Peak token throughput ~7000 tokens/sec.
- Reranker: internal search workload will spike during promotions; expect peaks of 250 qps with short contexts (~512 tokens). We'd like 99.9% availability SLA and a documented failover plan to a smaller model in case of capacity pressure.

Procurement (procurement@brightcart.com) — can you confirm our standard lead time for contracting? We'll need a canary period of 2 weeks after cutover.

I can do a 30-min sync Wed if you want to walk the sizing.

— Dana
Head of ML Platform, BrightCart
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BrightCart renewal — need sizing/pricing and SLA language

Team,

Fwding Dana's note. BrightCart is ready to expand at renewal; they're moving to a 32k model + adding a reranker. They asked for 99.9% SLA and a canary period. Please prepare:
- SKU and pricing breakdown (show both reserved + committed monthly cost and on-demand overage rates). Attach sku_pricing.xlsx.
- Draft SOW and SLA redline (include canary/cutover timeline, rollback criteria, and an explicit failover model for reranker to smaller variant).
- Recommended reserved pool configuration and autoscale policy (how many GPUs to pin vs burst).

I've attached the initial proposal and stub SOW from the customer attachment.

Thanks — need to share a commercial offer with procurement by Apr 18.

V.

Attachments referenced: sku_pricing.xlsx
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:37:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightCart renewal — need sizing/pricing and SLA language

Vanessa / Markus,

Technical sizing notes based on their numbers:
- Generation (32k model): recommend 8x A100 reserved GPUs (pinned) to meet baseline with headroom for steady traffic. This supports ~450 token/sec baseline with ~900 token/sec burst if KV-cache hits are high.
- Reranker pool: 4x A10 reserved with autoscale + 2x A10 burst. Reranker QPS patterns are spiky; keep lower-cost GPUs but reserve capacity to meet P95 latency targets.
- Quantization: we can offer an INT8 profile for the reranker (and eval for the 32k model) which reduces GPU memory and could reduce the committed GPUs by ~1-2 units if accepted.

Operational guarantees:
- Canary window: 14 days with telemetry hooks and rollback plan. We'll require feature-flagging and prefix cache warm-up before cutover.
- Throughput SLA: propose 99.8% for first 30 days post-cutover, rising to 99.9% after month 2 once canary metrics are met.

I'll drop the SKU numbers into sku_pricing.xlsx and attach a draft SOW. Let me know if legal needs tighter language on the rollback.

— Priyom
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana@brightcart.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Offer: BrightCart renewal — Dedicated GPU commitment & reranker add-on (BD-2027-089)

Dana / Procurement team,

Thanks for the constructive sync earlier this week. Attached is our revised commercial and legal package for the renewal and capacity expansion.

What we changed based on your inputs:
- Reserved pools: 8x A100 (generation, 32k model) + 4x A10 (reranker) with 2x A10 burst.
- Commitment: 12-month term; monthly reserved fee shown in sku_pricing.xlsx. Overage billed at on-demand rates, capped per month.
- SLA & Canary: 14-day canary, with 99.8% throughput SLA during canary, moving to 99.9% thereafter. Detailed rollback criteria included in Redwood_SOW_BrightCart_v3.pdf.
- Pricing: included a one-time migration credit to offset data-transfer and cutover cost. See line item in SKUs.

Attachments:
- redwood_sow_brightcart_v3.pdf
- sku_pricing.xlsx
- Updated-SLA.pdf

Action items for BrightCart:
1) Review and confirm acceptance of the SOW and SLA redlines.
2) Sign DocuSign link (https://docusign.com/brightcart/redwood/BD-2027-089) or confirm commercial counters by Apr 25 so we can lock capacity for May 15 start.
3) Share procurement lead contact and PO if you need a purchase order process.

If you'd like, we can schedule a technical kickoff with Priyom, Marissa (CS), and your ML infra team next Tuesday.

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
